Support operations

Ticket Surge Radar

I built a radar that spots spikes in support tickets and gives the team the evidence to decide whether to open an incident.

Independent project

The problem

A broken checkout can show up as several different complaints. A support lead needs to know whether those reports point to one growing problem.

The decision

I used a small text classifier to group reports, then used a separate count check to flag spikes. The brief links back to the source tickets so the team can check the pattern and investigate the cause.

What you can try

Run the fictional checkout replay. It shows 18 related reports in the latest six-hour window, up from an average of two in earlier windows. You can also load a support CSV and analyze it in your browser.
